question: How many purchase-surface presentations, authoritative allowance reaches, visible blocks, upgrade intents, checkout opens, client success navigations, and real restores occur per namespace/build? The eight Subscription-prefixed events use closed dimensions only. Allowance Block Shown counts actual rendered blocks including optimistic local refusal (unknown cause), independently of authoritative Allowance Reached. Legacy checkout resolution is preserved and cannot alone certify new completion telemetry. Paywall Viewed is once per presentation, Upgrade Tapped is CTA intent, Checkout Opened requires an actual checkout page/window, and Checkout Completed is configured-origin/exact-path verified success navigation ONLY, never accepted payment, entitlement or revenue. Upgrade-in-place and reactivation are not checkout completion. Cancellation, dismissal and load/request failures never complete; entitlement refresh or focus cannot manufacture completion. An observed success navigation may precede entitlement-refresh lag. Web completion observes only the static success-navigation return from the exact checkout window and configured API origin; opener isolation, page exit or the 30-minute observation expiry can leave it unobserved. External-browser native chat checkout has no completion return signal. Use authoritative server billing/invoice truth and its paid/trial classification. Billing Subscription Started is a lifecycle signal, not by itself proof of a charge. Restore is server refresh on Flutter only and must classify the fresh read/error, never stale paid state. Legacy Paywall Opened, Upgrade Plan Selected, Upgrade Succeeded and Upgrade Cancelled retain their prior behavior. Upgrade Modal Clicked/Dismissed are not purchase measurements. See contracts/analytics/PURCHASE_EXPOSURE.md for platform boundaries and limits.
zero_policy: Zero new events is expected before this client revision ships. Missing events are unobserved, not evidence of no exposure, cancellation, failed payment or no restore. Web return observation is best-effort and can be unavailable when the opener is isolated, the parent exits or the observer expires. External-browser native chat completion and native store restore are unsupported where no corresponding signal/action exists. Revenue and paid conversion must use authoritative server billing records, not these client observations.
